title: A power saving for planar halving lines
summary: There are absolute constants ε > 0 and C such that every sufficiently large even n -point set in the plane with no three collinear has at most $`Cn^{4/3-\varepsilon}`$ unordered halving pairs. This gives a power saving over the classical $`O(n^{4/3})`$ bound for planar halving lines. The proof is nonquantitative and does not supply explicit constants.
family_title: Power savings for planar halving lines and k -sets

review.reason: Improves the classical O(n^{4/3}) bound on planar halving pairs by a power saving.
